about: LARGE and SMALL's k and MOD across their forms, as the seventeenth Windows run and the area passes of 2026-10-12 read them (ADR-0047); A1:A10 hold 1 to 10, so the k-th largest is 11 - k and the k-th smallest k. A number compares exactly, -0 apart from 0, and an Error Value refused is written so. The cases themselves are in ExcelCases/large.json, small.json, aggregate.json and mod.json. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' KthAndModTests.
